calls.title: Tim Sjobeck and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The discussion centered on establishing a robust revenue operations infrastructure for GrowthBook as it faces growth challenges due to the absence of a dedicated Rev Ops leader. Tim Sjobeck will initially lead the Rev Ops efforts part-time, addressing operational gaps while Ashley Stirrup highlighted the disorganized data flows affecting sales and finance. There’s a critical need for improved customer data systems to clarify renewal processes and buyer journeys. Marketing operations require structured audits, including an unprioritized HubSpot audit, to focus on urgent improvements. Training and onboarding for new sales staff are informal, raising risks as the company plans to expand rapidly. Tim offered his consulting services at a flexible retainer model to guide strategic operations and align teams across functions.
calls.keywords: Rev Ops, GrowthBook, Sales Operations, Customer Success, Marketing Operations, Data Management

calls.title: Tim Sjobeck and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The team discussed the phased approach to optimizing the data warehouse by prioritizing high-impact data and removing lower-value sources like social media. They emphasized the importance of integrating GA4 and Google Tag Manager, exploring a new vendor for implementation. Additionally, a fractional CFO is engaged to clean up financial data, addressing billing and licensing inconsistencies for a reliable source of truth. Customer success processes are in early stages, focusing on basic tracking for top customers while aligning with future warehouse improvements. Lastly, the need to optimize consultant involvement and ensure clear communication across projects was highlighted for better accountability and coordination.
calls.keywords: Data Warehouse, GA4 Integration, Customer Success, Accounting Data Cleanup, Consultant Management, Project Prioritization
